QT/QTc are critical measurements linked to life-threatening arrhythmias. The app allows users to log details about each bowel movement, including date, time, consistency, color, and any accompanying symptoms. 

In addition to bowel movement details, the app provides a section for users to record any symptoms related to their digestive system, such as abdominal pain, bloating, and so on.

The app shows the main foods that you can eat and that you should avoid on a fodmap diet.
